summary.text: Vanessa LaFleur is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 101, which the House page lists as representing East Baton Rouge Parish, and was first elected in 2022. Her official House page lists her as Vice Chair of the Administration of Criminal Justice Committee.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists LaFleur's occupation as attorney and adjunct professor at the Southern University Law Center.
It lists her education as Baton Rouge Magnet High School, Southern University and A&M College, and the Southern University Law Center.
She is also listed as a member of the Appropriations and Judiciary committees and of the Democratic Caucus, the Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus and the Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus.

sources.title: Vanessa Caston LaFleur, District 101 (Louisiana House of Representatives)
